what: Stat badge shown under every unit on the board (owner design, Oct 24). Pictures cut from owner-reference.png (binding).

frame.note: Already contains the heart (Health), the left blue circle with a sword (Attack), the right green circle with a boot (Movement) and a center circle with a pickaxe. Do not use the separate sword/boot icons for these; they are in the frame.

unitTypeIcon.note: Laid exactly over the frame's center circle so the unit type can change.
unitTypeIcon.shield: spare icon for units whose card says Guard/Shield/defender (owner may assign later)

numbers.style: bold white numerals with a thick black outline (about 12% of the digit height) and a soft dark drop shadow, like owner-reference.png top row; font: Russo One (bundled)
numbers.note: Positions are the number's center, in percent of the frame picture's width/height. Numbers are live text so they change with damage, buffs, etc.
